model_annotation: The line plot displays the performance of four different models—Llama-3B, Llama-3B + FT, Llama-1B, and Llama-1B + FT—across eight distinct data points labeled η0 through η8 on the horizontal axis. The vertical axis represents a numerical metric, ranging from approximately 3.5 to 8.5. The plot features four distinct lines, each with a unique color and marker style: Llama-3B is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers; Llama-3B + FT is shown with a solid green line and triangle markers; Llama-1B is depicted by a dashed light blue line with square markers; and Llama-1B + FT is represented by a dashed light green line with inverted triangle markers. All four lines exhibit an overall upward trend, starting at a value of approximately 4.2 for Llama-3B at η0 and rising to a value of approximately 8.5 for Llama-3B + FT at η8. The Llama-3B and Llama-3B + FT models consistently achieve higher performance values than the Llama-1B and Llama-1B + FT models across the entire range of η values.
